job.job_description:
We are seeking a Generative AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications using Large Language Models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, AI agents, and modern GenAI frameworks.




Responsibilities:





Develop enterprise GenAI applications using LLMs.


Build RAG-based applications using enterprise data.


Integrate LLM APIs from OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and other providers.


Develop prompt templates and evaluation frameworks.


Build AI agents and tool-calling workflows.


Implement vector databases and semantic search.


Develop APIs and production-grade AI services.


Optimize model performance, latency, and cost.


Implement responsible AI and security practices.


Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and business teams.





Required Skills:





Generative AI / LLMs.


Python.


OpenAI/Azure OpenAI or equivalent LLM APIs.


RAG.


Vector databases.


LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks.


Prompt engineering.


REST APIs.


Cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.


Machine Learning fundamentals.
job.ai_reason: Strong production RAG experience and transferable cloud skills.

ai_evaluation.reason: Strong production RAG experience and transferable cloud skills.
